data.short_description: Has this porous, rocky landscape been eroded over centuries, through some manner of magical mischief, or is it merely made of some weirdly flesh-coloured cheese?

data.title: Giant Cauldron (animated)
data.short_description: Double, double toil and trouble, fire burn and cauldron bubble! As the days shorten, chill winds rise, and the weather cools, what could be better than a lovely pot full of soup?

data.title: Hell Maw (animated)
data.short_description: Whether this abominable, gaping gateway into the guts of Gehenna (or another Lower Plane of your preference) has freshly appeared in your world, or has been part of the landscape for as long as anyone can remember, it's probably not a favoured tourist loc

data.title: Neon City Streets
data.short_description: There are still plenty of darkened corners along this illuminated byway, and the open air café seems like a nice place to hang out as long as you don't mind the ultra-smog.
